messages.subject: For Douglas Pferdehirt | Government relations, stakeholder strategy and international energy technology
messages.body:
Dear TechnipFMC Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Douglas J. Pferdehirt, Chair and Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

TechnipFMC operates across offshore and energy-technology markets where project execution, institutional relationships, local value and stakeholder confidence affect long-term performance. That environment closely matches my current executive responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex resource, infrastructure and logistics matters.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of government relations, emerging-market stakeholder leadership and cross-functional execution could support TechnipFMC internationally. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to TechnipFMC.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
